verdict.rationale: Mintlify docs describe an out-of-the-box in-product search bar with relevance ranking that admins can tune via numeric 'boost' multipliers on page/section chunks, plus filters and result limits, confirming built-in relevance-ranked search rather than a bolt-on tool. However, there is no explicit documentation or evidence about typo-tolerance specifically. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation/testing of typo-tolerant fuzzy matching, independent benchmarking of search speed/quality, and hands-on user reports validating relevance ranking in practice.
